objective: Determine whether the scalar image on the selected WIDTH_CAPMASK_OWNER_DEPTH_HISTOGRAMS OOO motif quotient factors through lower-order hypergraph boundary data—descriptor-summary vertices and unordered descriptor-summary pairs—before retaining full triple-motif identity.
frozenHyperedge: unordered multiset of the three vertex identities in one OOO triple

candidates.name: VERTEX_BOUNDARY
candidates.definition: For each matched OOO residue, GF(2) parity of occurrences of each vertex identity across all residue hyperedges, counting multiplicity inside each hyperedge.

candidates.name: PAIR_BOUNDARY
candidates.definition: For each matched OOO residue, GF(2) parity of the three unordered vertex-identity pairs induced by every residue hyperedge, counting multiplicity.

candidates.name: VERTEX_PLUS_PAIR_BOUNDARY
candidates.definition: Direct sum of VERTEX_BOUNDARY and PAIR_BOUNDARY.

candidates.name: TRIPLE_MOTIF
candidates.definition: GF(2) parity of complete unordered three-vertex motif keys; EW-RS-067 reconstruction/control family.

structuralProcedure: Inherit EW-RS-065 matched degree<=2 dependencies and OOO residues unchanged.
Map exact descriptor IDs to the frozen EW-RS-067 vertex identity without outcomes.
Construct candidate boundary rows for every dependency before scalar replay.
Freeze a deterministic GF(2) basis for each candidate boundary image.
Only after structural bases are frozen replay the two-bit scalar residues.
measurements: candidate image rank on the OOO dependency residue space
kernel dimension relative to the selected EW-RS-067 triple-motif image
scalar image dimension on a structural candidate basis
antiCircularity: Vertex identity is frozen by EW-RS-067 and is not changed from scalar results.
Boundary operators are fixed combinatorially before scalar replay.
No vertex, pair, or triple key is selected using W/D/L.
The candidate order is frozen before execution.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: TRIPLE_MOTIF must reproduce the EW-RS-067 exact scalar factorization and motif image ranks 75,288,16.
Any candidate with zero structural residue but nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
A candidate is selected only if it has zero scalar contradictions on all three carriers.
No outcome-driven key exceptions are allowed.
nextIfBoundaryPasses: Freeze the coarsest common passing boundary as the structural syndrome carrier and reduce its scalar image before selecting closed coefficients.
nextIfOnlyTriplePasses: Record irreducibility to the declared hypergraph boundaries and move to mechanically generated circuit/exchange annotations rather than outcome-selected triple terms.
interpretationGuards: A passing boundary factorization is a bounded Q-V structural result, not yet a universal closed formula.
Boundary image rank is structural; individual deterministic basis elements are gauge representatives.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
